name: Radiant Cyber-Plasma Astro-Griffin
description: A hyper-majestic, biomechanical celestial griffin woven from shattered chrono-prisms and glowing liquid-plasma. Upgraded with a golden eagle head and beak, material-ID driven palettes (plasma wings / prism body / golden head), per-feather and per-facet color variation, triangular chrono-prism tessellation seams, faceted normals with 3-point lighting, Blinn-Phong specular, Fresnel plasma rim, ACES filmic tonemapping and real depth output.
